quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an alignment research institute developing scalable methods for value-aligned advanced AI.
quests.correctAnswer: Our institute develops scalable alignment techniques for advanced AI systems - the scientific and engineering methods that ensure artificial general intelligence acts in accordance with human values rather than optimising for proxies that diverge from them.
quests.hint: Lead with the proxy divergence risk.
quests.explanation: Proxy optimisation divergence is the precise technical mechanism of AI misalignment - naming it demonstrates depth.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a constitutional AI company embedding ethical constraints into model training from first principles.
quests.correctAnswer: Our approach embeds ethical constraints into AI training at the constitutional level rather than adding safety guardrails after - building alignment into the model's values rather than bolting restrictions onto its outputs.
quests.hint: Lead with the constitutional versus guardrail contrast.
quests.explanation: Constitutional alignment versus post-hoc guardrails is a genuine technical distinction that AI safety audiences immediately recognise.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an interpretability research company developing tools to understand what advanced AI systems do.
quests.correctAnswer: Our interpretability tools reveal what computations advanced AI systems are actually performing - moving AI from a black box we hope is aligned to a system whose internal reasoning we can verify.
quests.hint: Lead with the black box to verifiable contrast.
quests.explanation: Black box to verifiable is the clearest possible framing of what interpretability research achieves.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a post-quantum cryptography company securing global communication infrastructure.
quests.correctAnswer: Our post-quantum algorithms secure communications against the quantum computers that will break current encryption within a decade - protecting data whose confidentiality must extend far beyond that horizon.
quests.hint: Lead with the data whose confidentiality must extend beyond a decade.
quests.explanation: Data with decade-plus confidentiality requirements is the use case that makes post-quantum migration urgent today.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an exascale computing service enabling complex scientific simulations.
quests.correctAnswer: Our exascale computing service enables climate pharmaceutical and materials science simulations of a complexity that previous computing generations made computationally impossible - opening scientific questions that could not previously be asked.
quests.hint: Lead with the questions that could not previously be asked.
quests.explanation: Scientific questions previously impossible to ask is the most expansive framing of what new computing capability enables.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a whole brain emulation research company mapping neural architecture at synaptic resolution.
quests.correctAnswer: Our research programme is generating the first complete synaptic-resolution map of mammalian brain architecture - the scientific foundation from which whole brain emulation will eventually become computationally tractable.
quests.hint: Lead with the computationally tractable framing.
quests.explanation: Computationally tractable positions the research as a step toward a specific engineering goal rather than pure basic science.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a clinical CRISPR base editing programme offering a one-time cure for sickle cell disease.
quests.correctAnswer: Our base editing programme corrects the single genetic error that causes sickle cell disease - a one-time curative treatment for a condition affecting millions with no adequate current therapy.
quests.hint: Lead with the one-time cure framing.
quests.explanation: One-time cure is the most powerful possible commercial and moral pitch for a single-correction genetic disease.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a precision fermentation company producing animal-identical dairy proteins without animals.
quests.correctAnswer: Our precision fermentation produces milk proteins molecularly identical to those from cows - enabling dairy products with exactly the nutrition of conventional dairy and zero animal agriculture.
quests.hint: Lead with molecularly identical and zero animal.
quests.explanation: Molecularly identical combined with zero animal addresses both quality sceptics and ethics-motivated buyers.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a cultivated meat company achieving cost parity with conventional beef.
quests.correctAnswer: Our process innovations have brought cultivated beef to cost parity with conventional production - making price the final barrier to fall in the transition to animal-free protein.
quests.hint: Lead with the final barrier framing.
quests.explanation: Final barrier creates a narrative of near-completion that makes investment feel like the decisive move.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a space-based solar power company beaming clean energy from orbit to Earth.
quests.correctAnswer: Our orbital solar platform harvests continuous solar energy in space and beams it to Earth as microwave radiation - clean baseload power available twenty-four hours a day unaffected by weather or seasons.
quests.hint: Lead with the weather and seasons independence.
quests.explanation: Independence from weather night and seasons is the fundamental advantage of space-based solar over any terrestrial alternative.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an AI deliberative democracy platform enabling large-scale informed citizen participation.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform enables tens of thousands of citizens to deliberate on policy questions with AI-facilitated information access - scaling the quality of informed democratic participation beyond what any physical assembly can achieve.
quests.hint: Lead with the scaling of quality participation.
quests.explanation: Scaling quality rather than just quantity of democratic participation is the distinction that makes AI deliberation meaningful.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a civilisational risk mapping platform identifying and quantifying existential risks.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform maps and quantifies existential and global catastrophic risks across a unified framework - enabling philanthropists governments and researchers to allocate risk reduction resources where they will have the greatest expected impact.
quests.hint: Lead with the expected impact allocation.
quests.explanation: Expected impact allocation converts risk mapping from analysis to action-guiding intelligence.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a universal basic services advocacy platform modelling the economics of essential service provision.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform models the full economic case for universal basic services - demonstrating that guaranteeing healthcare housing education and internet access generates more economic activity than it costs.
quests.hint: Lead with the generates more than it costs claim.
quests.explanation: Generates more than it costs converts universal basic services from a welfare expense to a macroeconomic investment.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a digital public infrastructure company building open-source government service platforms.
quests.correctAnswer: Our company builds open-source government service platforms that any country can adopt and adapt - preventing every government from solving the same digital problems independently and expensively.
quests.hint: Lead with the solving-same-problems-independently waste.
quests.explanation: Preventing duplicated government technology investment is the efficiency argument that makes digital public goods compelling.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a national resilience planning platform integrating infrastructure climate and social vulnerability data.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform integrates infrastructure condition climate exposure and social vulnerability into a national resilience map - enabling governments to invest where it will make the greatest difference before crisis strikes.
quests.hint: Lead with the greatest difference before crisis framing.
quests.explanation: Investment prioritisation before crisis is the shift from reactive recovery to strategic resilience.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a trade finance digitisation platform eliminating paper from letters of credit.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform digitises the entire letter of credit process - eliminating paper documentation that still characterises ninety per cent of trade finance and cutting processing time from days to hours.
quests.hint: Lead with the ninety per cent paper statistic.
quests.explanation: Ninety per cent of trade finance still using paper is a striking anachronism that makes digitisation immediately relevant.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a labour market reform platform modelling the impact of automation on workforce composition.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform models how automation will reshape workforce composition sector by sector over a decade - giving policymakers the evidence base for retraining investment and social protection design before displacement hits.
quests.hint: Lead with the before displacement hits timing.
quests.explanation: Before displacement hits is the proactive policy design frame that separates genuinely useful labour market intelligence from reactive analysis.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a post-scarcity governance research institute modelling economic institutions for abundance.
quests.correctAnswer: Our institute models how economic institutions need to redesign when automation makes physical scarcity negligible - preparing the theoretical and practical frameworks that will be needed as productivity continues to compound.
quests.hint: Lead with the productivity compounding framing.
quests.explanation: Productivity compounding beyond previous rates is the economic trajectory that makes post-scarcity governance research both urgent and credible.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a synthetic biology biosecurity monitoring platform for engineered pathogen surveillance.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform uses computational and wet-lab methods to monitor for engineered pathogens in environmental samples globally - providing the early warning system that biosecurity frameworks currently lack entirely.
quests.hint: Lead with the currently lacks entirely diagnosis.
quests.explanation: Currently lacks entirely is an honest diagnosis that frames biosecurity monitoring as building from nothing rather than improving on something.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an AI safety testing and red-teaming platform for frontier model developers.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform provides systematic red-teaming and safety evaluation for AI models before deployment - identifying failure modes misalignment and harmful capabilities that internal testing consistently misses.
quests.hint: Lead with what internal testing misses.
quests.explanation: Failure modes that internal testing misses is the precise gap that independent safety evaluation fills.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a resource allocation algorithm company designing optimal distribution mechanisms for public goods.
quests.correctAnswer: Our company designs market mechanisms that allocate public goods - spectrum bandwidth carbon capacity urban space - in ways that maximise total social welfare rather than simply selling to the highest bidder.
quests.hint: Lead with the versus selling to the highest bidder contrast.
quests.explanation: Contrast with auction-to-highest-bidder is the clearest way to convey that optimal public goods allocation requires different design.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a long-termist institutional design consultancy helping organisations plan on century timescales.
quests.correctAnswer: Our consultancy helps institutions design structures and incentives that plan and invest on century timescales - correcting the short-termism that makes current institutions consistently sacrifice the future for the present.
quests.hint: Lead with the future-sacrificed-for-present diagnosis.
quests.explanation: Future sacrificed for present is a morally compelling and practically accurate critique of current institutional design.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a global coordination infrastructure company building the foundation for international collective action.
quests.correctAnswer: Our company builds the shared technical infrastructure - identity authentication commitment verification and enforcement - that enables international collective action on problems that individual nations cannot solve alone.
quests.hint: Lead with the problems no nation can solve alone.
quests.explanation: Problems no nation can solve alone defines the global coordination problems that justify multilateral technical infrastructure.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a digital sovereignty framework advisory company navigating data localisation requirements globally.
quests.correctAnswer: Our advisory company helps multinationals navigate the conflicting data localisation requirements of every jurisdiction they operate in - designing architectures that achieve genuine compliance without fragmenting global data infrastructure.
quests.hint: Lead with the conflicting requirements problem.
quests.explanation: Conflicting data localisation requirements across jurisdictions is a genuine and growing complexity.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a sovereign wealth fund performance benchmarking and governance advisory platform.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform benchmarks sovereign wealth fund performance against global peers and provides governance advisory - giving fund boards the independent evidence they need to fulfil fiduciary responsibilities.
quests.hint: Lead with the independent fiduciary evidence.
quests.explanation: Independent evidence for fiduciary accountability is the primary governance need in sovereign wealth fund management.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an interplanetary supply chain company developing logistics for cislunar commerce.
quests.correctAnswer: Our company designs the supply chain infrastructure for the emerging cislunar economy - propulsion-efficient cargo routing orbital depot positioning and surface logistics for a sustained human presence beyond Earth.
quests.hint: Lead with the sustained human presence framing.
quests.explanation: Sustained human presence beyond Earth frames cislunar logistics as essential infrastructure rather than speculative technology.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a space resource property rights advisory company navigating the emerging legal framework.
quests.correctAnswer: Our advisory company helps organisations navigate the emerging legal framework for space resource property rights - providing the jurisdictional structuring that space resource ventures require before any legal clarity exists.
quests.hint: Lead with the before any clarity exists urgency.
quests.explanation: Before any legal clarity exists is the moment when advisory expertise is most valuable and competitive advantage is created.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an ocean acidification emergency response platform coordinating international intervention.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform coordinates international scientific and policy responses to ocean acidification - providing the governance infrastructure for a crisis that no single nation and no existing multilateral institution is currently equipped to address.
quests.hint: Lead with the governance gap no institution addresses.
quests.explanation: Naming the governance gap creates the space for a coordination platform that fills it.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a post-human capability enhancement company developing cognitive augmentation for professionals.
quests.correctAnswer: Our company develops cognitive augmentation for professional applications - memory enhancement attention extension and processing acceleration that extend human professional capability beyond biological baseline in specific high-stakes domains.
quests.hint: Lead with the specific high-stakes domains.
quests.explanation: High-stakes domain specificity makes cognitive augmentation credible by contrast with broad enhancement claims.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch the most important company you could found to maximise long-term human flourishing.
quests.correctAnswer: Our company builds the global coordination infrastructure for existential risk reduction - aligning governments corporations and civil society around challenges whose failure would end human civilisation and whose success would open it to its greatest possible chapter.
quests.hint: Lead with opening to the greatest chapter.
quests.explanation: Opening to the greatest chapter is the positive framing of existential risk reduction - not just preventing catastrophe but enabling the most expansive possible human future.
